title: Ultra Crispy Filipino Chicken Canton Pancit
description: A twist on the classic Filipino dish, this version features crispy fried chicken in a savory Canton-style pancit.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together 1 cup of vegetable oil, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1/2 cup of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and shallots to the skillet and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Canton-style noodles to the skillet and cook according to package instructions.
Add the soy sauce, fish sauce (if using), and red chilli flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the chicken and noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
